items.title: Abimelech son of Gideon
items.charge: Murder of seventy brothers on one stone; usurping a crown

items.title: Absalom
items.charge: Murder of Amnon; conspiracy and rebellion against the king his father; lying with his father's concubines

items.title: Achan
items.charge: Taking devoted spoil from Jericho

items.title: Adonijah
items.charge: Exalting himself to be king; asking for the king's concubine

items.title: Agag king of the Amalekites
items.charge: The sword that made women childless

items.title: Ahab
items.charge: Marrying Jezebel; serving Baal; sparing Ben-hadad whom the Lord appointed to destruction

items.title: Ahab the son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah
items.charge: Prophesying lies in the Lord's name to the captives; committing adultery with their neighbours' wives

items.title: Ahaziah of Israel
items.charge: Inquiring of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron

items.title: Ahaziah of Judah
items.charge: Walking in the ways of the house of Ahab, his mother being his counsellor to do wickedly

items.title: Ahithophel
items.charge: Treason against David; counsel of incest; suicide

items.title: Alcimus
items.charge: Slandering Judas to the king; slaying sixty Asideans under a sworn peace; pulling down the wall of the inner court

items.title: Aman, who ensnared Achiacharus
items.charge: Treachery against the man who brought him up

items.title: Amaziah
items.charge: Bringing home the gods of Seir and bowing to them

items.title: Amnon
items.charge: Rape of his sister Tamar

items.title: Amon
items.charge: Serving his father's idols and refusing his father's repentance

items.title: Ananias and Sapphira
items.charge: Lying to the Holy Spirit about a gift

items.title: Andronicus
items.charge: Murder of Onias the high priest under a sworn assurance

items.title: Antiochus Epiphanes
items.charge: Defiling the temple; forbidding the law; murdering the faithful

items.title: Apollonius
items.charge: Falling upon Jerusalem on the Sabbath under a pretence of peace; slaying a great multitude; taking women and children captive

items.title: Athaliah
items.charge: Destroying the seed royal of Judah; usurping the throne

items.title: Baanah and Rechab
items.charge: Murder of Ish-bosheth in his bed

items.title: Baasha
items.charge: Walking in the way of Jeroboam after being raised up to destroy Jeroboam's house

items.title: Balaam
items.charge: Divination for hire; counseling Moab to seduce Israel into idolatry

items.title: Belshazzar
items.charge: Drinking from the temple vessels and praising the gods of gold and silver

items.title: Ben-hadad and the Syrians at Aphek
items.charge: Saying the Lord is a god of the hills and not of the valleys

items.title: Bigthan and Teresh
items.charge: Conspiring to lay hands on king Ahasuerus

items.title: Daniel's accusers
items.charge: Conspiring by law against an innocent man

items.title: Eglon king of Moab
items.charge: Possessing the city of palm trees and taking tribute of Israel eighteen years

items.title: Eli and his sons
items.charge: Corrupt priesthood; a father who would not restrain it

items.title: Er and Onan
items.charge: Wickedness before the Lord; refusing to raise up seed to a dead brother

items.title: Goliath of Gath
items.charge: Defying the armies of the living God, morning and evening, forty days

items.title: Haman the Agagite
items.charge: Plotting the destruction of all the Jews; building a gallows for Mordecai

items.title: Hananiah the son of Azur
items.charge: Prophesying a lie in the name of the Lord

items.title: Hazael king of Syria
items.charge: Smothering his master to take the throne, and doing to Israel the evil Elisha wept over

items.title: Herod Agrippa
items.charge: Accepting worship due to God alone

items.title: Holofernes
items.charge: Making Nebuchadnezzar a god; blasphemy against the God of Israel; lust and drunkenness

items.title: Jabin and Sisera
items.charge: Mightily oppressing Israel twenty years with nine hundred chariots of iron

items.title: Jehoram of Judah
items.charge: Slaying all his brethren with the sword; walking in the way of the house of Ahab; making high places and compelling Judah to fornication

items.title: Jezebel
items.charge: Killing the prophets of the Lord; promoting Baal; witchcrafts

items.title: Jezebel and Naboth's vineyard
items.charge: Judicial murder to seize an inheritance

items.title: Jezebel of Thyatira
items.charge: Calling herself a prophetess; teaching the servants of God to commit fornication and eat things sacrificed to idols

items.title: Joab
items.charge: Murder of Abner and Amasa in time of peace

items.title: Joash of Judah
items.charge: Forsaking the Lord after Jehoiada's death; stoning Zechariah in the temple court

items.title: Johanan and the remnant that went down to Egypt
items.charge: Asking the word of the Lord, swearing to obey it, and refusing it; burning incense to the queen of heaven in Egypt

items.title: Josiah at Megiddo
items.charge: Going to battle against Necho without inquiring of the Lord

items.title: Judas Iscariot
items.charge: Theft from the common purse; betraying innocent blood for thirty pieces of silver

items.title: Judas' soldiers with idol tokens under their coats
items.charge: Carrying things consecrated to idols into battle

items.title: King Saul
items.charge: Unlawful sacrifice; sparing what was devoted; consulting a medium

items.title: Korah, Dathan, and Abiram
items.charge: Rebellion against God-appointed authority

items.title: Lot's wife
items.charge: Looking back toward Sodom against the angel's command

items.title: Lysimachus
items.charge: Sacrilege: robbing the temple with Menelaus' consent

items.title: Menelaus
items.charge: Buying the priesthood over Jason; stealing the temple vessels; procuring the murder of Onias; bribing his way past the king's judgment

items.title: Nabal
items.charge: Churlish refusal of hospitality; railing on the Lord's anointed

items.title: Nadab and Abihu
items.charge: Offering strange fire not commanded

items.title: Nicanor
items.charge: Blasphemy against the temple; breaking covenant with Judas; resolving to attack on the Sabbath

items.title: Nineveh under Nahum
items.charge: A bloody city, full of lies and robbery, mistress of witchcrafts

items.title: Pelatiah and the princes at the east gate
items.charge: Devising mischief and giving wicked counsel in the city

items.title: Samson
items.charge: Marrying a Philistine; going in to a harlot; betraying his Nazarite vow to Delilah

items.title: Saul's house and the Gibeonites
items.charge: Breaking Israel's sworn covenant by slaying the Gibeonites

items.title: Sennacherib and Rabshakeh
items.charge: Reproaching the living God; setting him among the gods of the nations that could not save

items.title: Sheba son of Bichri
items.charge: Insurrection: we have no part in David

items.title: Shechem son of Hamor
items.charge: Defiling Dinah, daughter of Jacob

items.title: Shimei son of Gera
items.charge: Cursing the king and casting stones at him

items.title: Sihon and Og
items.charge: Refusing Israel passage and coming out to battle against them

items.title: Sodom and Gomorrah
items.charge: Grievous sin; inhospitality and violence against strangers

items.title: The Amalekite who claimed to kill Saul
items.charge: Claiming to have slain the Lord's anointed

items.title: The blasphemer in the camp
items.charge: Blaspheming the Name in a quarrel

items.title: The elders with idols in the temple (Ezekiel 8)
items.charge: The image of jealousy; creeping things on the walls; women weeping for Tammuz; twenty-five men worshipping the sun with their backs to the temple

items.title: The generation of the Flood
items.charge: Corruption and violence filling the earth

items.title: The generation that died in the wilderness
items.charge: Ten provocations; unbelief at Kadesh-barnea

items.title: The Hellenizers who forsook the holy covenant
items.charge: Covenanting with the heathen; removing circumcision; profaning the Sabbath; sacrificing to idols

items.title: The Jew who sacrificed at Modin
items.charge: Sacrificing on the heathen altar at the king's command

items.title: The lord on whose hand the king leaned
items.charge: Scoffing at the word of the Lord by Elisha in the famine of Samaria

items.title: The man gathering sticks on the Sabbath
items.charge: Working on the Sabbath

items.title: The man of God from Judah
items.charge: Turning back to eat and drink at Bethel against the word of the Lord

items.title: The man who refused the prophetic command
items.charge: Refusing a command delivered in the word of the Lord

items.title: The men of Beth-shemesh
items.charge: Looking into the ark of the Lord

items.title: The men of Gibeah, and Benjamin
items.charge: Sodomy, gang rape and murder of a stranger's concubine; a tribe that shielded the guilty

items.title: The men of Joppa
items.charge: Drowning two hundred of the Jews that dwelt among them, under a pretence of peace

items.title: The men of Succoth and Penuel
items.charge: Refusing bread to the Lord's army in pursuit, and taunting them with it

items.title: The Midianites, in the matter of Peor
items.charge: Beguiling Israel with their wiles into fornication and the worship of Baal-peor

items.title: The penitent thief
items.charge: Robbery, under sentence of crucifixion

items.title: The priests of Bel
items.charge: Deceiving the king and the people with an idol that seemed to eat

items.title: The prince of Tyre
items.charge: Saying, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God

items.title: The prophets of Baal at Carmel
items.charge: Prophesying in the name of other gods

items.title: The two elders who accused Susanna
items.charge: Attempted adultery by extortion; false witness against an innocent woman

items.title: Timotheus
items.charge: Gathering the heathen to root out the Jews; a second campaign after being once spared

items.title: Uzzah and the ark
items.charge: Touching the ark, transported unlawfully

items.title: Zimri
items.charge: Conspiring against his master Elah as he drank himself drunk; slaying all the house of Baasha

items.title: Zimri and Cozbi
items.charge: Bringing a Midianite woman into the camp in the sight of the congregation
